books.title: The Runaway Robot
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Dr. Patel built a small robot called Bolt to help in her workshop. Bolt could sweep, sort screws, and make tea.
One day Bolt saw the open door and wondered what was outside. Before anyone could stop him, he rolled out into the garden.
Bolt rolled down the street, past the bakery and the park, waving at everyone he met. The children followed him, laughing.
At the park, Bolt helped an old man carry his shopping and picked up litter with his long arms. Everyone cheered.
When Dr. Patel found him, she was not angry. 'You wanted an adventure,' she said. 'And you helped people too.'
Now Bolt goes out every Saturday with Dr. Patel. He still helps in the workshop, but he never misses his walk in the park.

books.title: The Hidden Cave
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: While hiking in the hills, Adam and his cousin Zoe found a small opening behind a waterfall.
'It is a cave!' whispered Zoe. 'Shall we look inside?' Adam nodded, and they stepped in carefully with their torches.
Inside, the cave was full of sparkling crystals. They glittered blue, pink, and gold in the torchlight.
In the middle of the cave they found a pool of clear water. Tiny silver fish swam in circles, shining like stars.
Adam and Zoe sat quietly and listened to the water dripping. It was the most peaceful place they had ever found.
They promised to keep the cave a secret, so it would stay beautiful and safe. Some treasures are best left exactly where they are.

books.title: The Brave Little Firefighter
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Sam wanted to be a firefighter when he grew up, just like his mum. He practised every day with his toy fire truck.
One evening, the smoke alarm in the kitchen started to beep. Sam's mum was outside, and Sam was alone in the living room.
Sam remembered what his mum had taught him. He stayed low, covered his mouth, and walked calmly to the front door.
Outside, he called his neighbour, who rang for the fire engine. The firefighters came quickly and put out the small fire.
The fire chief said, 'You did exactly the right thing, Sam. Staying calm and getting out saved the day.'
Sam smiled. He knew that being brave was not about fighting fires. It was about knowing what to do and staying calm.

books.title: The Little Sailor
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Tom lived in a small village by the sea, and he dreamed of becoming a sailor. Every day he watched the big ships sail away to faraway lands.
One sunny morning, Captain Rose came to the village and said, "I need a young sailor to help me on my ship. Who wants to come?" Tom jumped up at once.
On the ship, Tom learned to tie knots, climb the mast, and read the stars at night. The work was hard, but Tom loved every minute of it.
Suddenly, a great storm came. The waves were huge, and the wind howled. Tom held the rope tight and helped the captain steer the ship to safety.
When the storm passed, Captain Rose smiled at Tom. "You are a true sailor now," she said. Tom sailed home proud, knowing his dream had come true.
